# runzero_service (Data Source)

Fetches a single RunZero service by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the asset.

### Read-Only

- `alive` (Boolean) Whether the asset is alive.
- `comments` (String) Comments on the asset.
- `created_at` (Number) Asset creation timestamp (Unix epoch).
- `first_seen` (Number) First seen timestamp (Unix epoch).
- `hw` (String) The hardware identifier.
- `last_seen` (Number) Last seen timestamp (Unix epoch).
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID.
- `os` (String) The operating system.
- `service_address` (String) The address of the service.
- `service_asset_id` (String) The asset ID associated with the service.
- `service_created_at` (Number) Service creation timestamp (Unix epoch).
- `service_id` (String) The UUID of the service.
- `service_link` (String) A link to the service.
- `service_port` (String) The port of the service.
- `service_protocol` (String) The application protocol of the service.
- `service_summary` (String) A summary of the service.
- `service_transport` (String) The transport protocol (tcp, udp).
- `service_updated_at` (Number) Service last update timestamp (Unix epoch).
- `service_vhost` (String) The virtual host of the service.
- `site_id` (String) The site ID.
- `type` (String) The asset type.
- `updated_at` (Number) Asset last update timestamp (Unix epoch).
